The pairwise square-root balancing operation on the B,C coefficient layers preserves ||P||_2. For each convolution exponent, vector triangle bounds AB/AC and BD/CD terms and the 2x2 Frobenius estimate gives X^2+Y^2+4Z^2<=6W^2; the BC<=F^2 comparison also controls AD+BC. If b_U!=c_U, the unique decomposition of exponent 2*1_U gives W-Z=(b_U-c_U)^2/2>0, forcing strict improvement. All maximizers have constant magnitudes by Johnson-graph connectivity. Ordered-pair intersection counting gives the exact constant C_nk=binom(n,k)^-1 sum_{r=0}^{min(k,n-k)}binom(k,r)binom(n-k,r)binom(2r,r). Product-phase equality gives rectangle relations, independent coordinate ratios, and a character cocycle for 2<=k<=n-2; k=n and k=n-1 are checked separately. Independent exact Fourier-convolution calculations checked (n,k)=(4,3),(5,3),(6,3),(8,3),(8,4), agreeing with the formula.
